content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6-2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. That's roughly 1.6 g/kg as a solid baseline, and going up to 2.2 g/kg won't hurt if it's easy for you. Spread it across 3-5 meals, with about 0.3-0.4 g/kg each. Keep total calories in a small surplus too, since that's what fuels the bench press toward 100 kg 💪

If you tell me your bodyweight, I'll work out your daily number.
